Resolves #21577

`Neo.grid.plugin.AnimateRows` now moves a record whose own change re-sorts the store, as it moves one for a header sort. The plugin also takes the body's `onStoreRecordChange` and `onStoreRowsChange`. After the body repaints a changed row, the plugin holds every row of a move that has not started at its first-step offset (`hold`, `holdPending`), and `#pending` carries each row's previous index for that. A changed record that keeps its index repaints with no transition, as before.

Evidence: L3 (an e2e over the Neural Link on the real example, red on `dev` and green at head; per-frame offset receipts on #21570's live leaderboard) → L3 required (AC-1 is rendered motion). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/grid/AnimateRowsRecordChangeNL.spec.mjs`, whose first half asserts that a re-sorted record passes through the offsets between. It fails with only `AnimateRows.mjs` swapped to `origin/dev`. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `AnimatedRowSorting.spec.mjs` (6 arms: header sorts, filters, no transition outside a move, the duration field) and `test/playwright/unit/grid/` (549 specs, including `AnimateRowsSteps` and `AnimateRowsContentSized`). Also green locally at head. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: the second half of the same NL spec. Amanda goes from 100 to 99, keeps the first row, and no row transitions. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The new spec joins `ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS` (`test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs`). It dispatches to the page's own App Worker, so like `GridExportCsvNL` it runs without a Brain checkout.

## Test Evidence

Red on `dev`: with only `src/grid/plugin/AnimateRows.mjs` swapped to `origin/dev` and `--repeat-each=3`, all 3 runs fail with `a frame between the two rows: 128, 128, 32, 32, …`. At head, 10 of 10 pass (`--repeat-each=10`).

On #21570's own example (its three files overlaid on this head), a per-frame sampler classified every automatic move over 9 s, twice. Result: **0 jumps**, against 39 and 11 glides. On `dev` the same example gave 8 jumps per run.

- [x] Once #21570 merges, its leaderboard's overtaking rows glide on `dev` (the same sampler, or a look at the example). *Confirmed Fri 20 Nov 18:20 UTC on `dev` at `8ed566ae7d` (#21570 merged): the row that the first timer update moves from third to first (Carol) passes 64 → 60 → 57 → … → 1 → 0 px through 29 frame values, the same in two runs; before this fix it read 64 → 0 in one step.*
